text:
Maya: Final pin-down thread for the GA acceptance matrix. Need a compact customer-facing section that covers: exact SLA numbers, what we surface in Console at each tier, monitoring alert thresholds + runbook link, billing footnotes (burst vs reserved) and the customer sign-off flow. Who will own each micro-section?
Priya: Docs will own the one-pager and the "What you see in Console" callouts. I'll need the final SLO table and a short FAQ entry for telemetry opt-outs.
Raj: I'll own SLA wording and credit math. Proposed table: Bronze = best-effort; Silver = 95th <= 120ms; Gold = 95th <= 80ms + 99th <= 200ms (Gold only on Dedicated/Reserved). Credits: cap at 50% monthly, calculated proportional to impacted token-seconds.
Omar: Engineering: implementable constraints: 95th per-route + error% per-route by GA for Silver/Gold. 99th only for Gold and only in Dedicated due to cost. Private installs: route-level telemetry behind flag route_metrics (default off). We'll add a per-deployment toggle for fallback_to_variant.
Lina: SRE/runbook: alert rules + canary plan. Example alert (PromQL-ish):
```
alert: customer_route_slo_page
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, customer_id)) > ROUTE_THRESHOLD
for: 6m
```
Error-rate alert:
```
alert: customer_route_error_page
expr: sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m])) by (route, customer_id) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route, customer_id) > 0.005
for: 10m
```
Runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/ops/ga-sla-runbook (will add escalation matrix + verification job).
Priya: For Console mockups I want: Bronze = aggregate latency card; Silver = per-region 95th + error%; Gold = per-route 95th/99th + error% + per-route traffic heatmap. Also include a modal explaining telemetry overhead when enabling per-route metrics.
Maya: Billing/legal items?
legal-bot: Add dispute window: SLA claims must be submitted within 30 days of incident end with supporting logs. Force majeure, customer-side network issues, and scheduled maintenance excluded from SLA. We'll supply canonical phrasing.
finance-bot: Billing note: Reserved/Dedicated customers get 10% unit discount + throughput guarantees. Burst (hosted) customers are best-effort; overage billed at overage rate; sustained >10% above quota for 24h may be throttled. Credit calc: prorate by affected_token_seconds/total_token_seconds; cap 50%. We'll provide a worked example for the doc.
Priya: Docs action items: SLA one-pager + Console visuals + FAQ (48h). Need exact SLO numbers confirmation.
Raj: SLA doc action: finalize language for "backfill" and rollback policy and draft credit example (24h).
Omar: Eng action items: PR for route_metrics flag + admin toggle screenshot (48h); API for fallback_to_variant and telemetry tags (fallback=true) for billing/analytics (72h).
Lina: Ops action items: insert alert rules into runbook, add synthetic canary plan (72h), schedule 72h pre-GA canary. I'll attach a verification job that produces an "impacted_customers" report for disputes.
Maya: Customer sign-off flow: product will publish the one-pager and ask customers to acknowledge SLA T&Cs via Console opt-in for Gold. Priya draft the opt-in flow copy.
Priya: Will draft opt-in modal: "Enable per-route metrics and SLA opt-in (Gold/Dedicated)." Include checkbox for telemetry opt-out with note about impact on credit validation.
Maya: Timeline: target consolidated sign-off doc 2026-05-03 AM UTC. Deploy window for GA config push?
deploy-bot: Planned GA config push: 2026-05-07 02:00 UTC (maintenance window).
Maya: Good. If anyone can't hit ETAs, flag here. Otherwise I'll stitch these sections into the final customer-facing doc and circulate for legal/finance sign-off. :white_check_mark:
